issues: The evaluator treats event=accept as name confirmation, although Brief A rule 3 explicitly excludes generic assent such as 'go ahead'. The initial prompt also references identity_prompt and callback_facts before either is initialized.

Security-result prompts are overwritten when verify returns through evaluate. The existing phase_after_result flag is never consumed. A complete corrected answer can also be concatenated with an obsolete partial answer, preventing the corrected answer from reaching verification.
After a verification service failure, the hold branch ignores a newly supplied corrected answer and only permits resubmission of the previous answer.

The callback implementation invents a requirement that an invalid proposal must contain both date and time before consuming the retry allowance. Brief A rule 7 applies when either the offered day or time is outside the window. Impossible dates also bypass this allowance indefinitely.
A third party who supplies callback details in their first reply has those details discarded by the third_party branch.

Product extraction requests internal product IDs without supplying those IDs to the extraction model. The schema also cannot represent different amounts or dates for multiple products in one reply, and an aggregate amount can be incorrectly applied separately to every product.

Clarifications discard the proposal being clarified. For example, a read-back correction with an unspecified product loses its date when the customer subsequently identifies the product. A shared vague date becomes a first-product-only proposal, and its associated amount can be lost.

The amount branches discard a simultaneously proposed date when offering the floor or full amount. A repeated below-floor proposal can also consume a persuasion attempt even though a proposed amount is not a refusal.
A hardship statement containing a voluntary date or amount bypasses the required support offer instead of preserving the proposal while offering support.
When an already-paid claim resolves the last product, advance discards the required statement that payments can take one business day to appear.
The confirmation branch routes directly to save_promise without passing through the validation performed by the writing branch.
Every extracted factual question receives 'I do not have that information', including questions answerable from the loaded account.
